new_diagnostic: For each original tag x original year, select exactly the same source q-qualified tagged solar dates and same 2+ year-month blocks used in the earlier year-month FE; on these SAME dates and same original tags calculate (A) unadjusted q~daylength slope across all selected dates, (B) within-year-month FE slope, (B-A) paired within-tag slope difference. Compute per-tag equal mean of qualified original-year slopes; source-native equal tag mean and 2000 paired tag-bootstrap percentile 95 intervals. Same date/calendar/month sample for all A/B/Delta; repeat with fixed source reference latitude as sensitivity. Never compare confidence intervals as if independent; do not interpret regression adjustment as a causal month effect.
primary_local_vs_fixed_lat_source_sampli: Use exactly the same original source date and month selection as the already frozen first five source results, using both local and fixed source-reference-latitude daylength opportunity gates.
inference_scope: A paired within-source statistical decomposition of month adjustment vs month-qualified sample selection, not an independent same-species ecological replication, not a daylength treatment effect, not global wildlife inference; original source GPS/telemetry schedule differs between studies.
